pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo gihiveyyāvaccaṃ karontīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.9: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya . . .
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī gihiveyyāvaccaṃ kareyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc44:2.1.6: agārikassa yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā khādaniyaṃ vā pacati, sāṭakaṃ vā veṭṭhanaṃ vā dhovati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
